_comment: What the files of the project do not say about a third-party component.
Names and versions are extracted by .github/scripts/third_party_inventory.py: never write them here.
Each entry applies to the components of the same kind whose name matches the pattern (fnmatch, case-sensitive); the first match wins, so specific entries go before generic ones.
A license detected from the component itself takes precedence over the license written here.
Categories: A = part of the game; B = decides whether a change passes (process tool); editor = editor only, neither in the game nor a check.
